seed_selection: Seeds 900 through 904 are a contiguous held-out range not used by any committed suite, development example, probe, or persisted run inspected before selection. This is the Scout baseline (ADR 0004 section 8): Scout has no NLE success state and its action profile cannot eat, so the case is gated by metric thresholds and requires no objective success. The thresholds were fixed before any scout-v1 episode ran, from development-only scripted-model probes of the same case on seeds 800 through 804: 0/5 explore_dungeon(3) completions; explored cells 964, 625, 320, 557, 554 (median 557); Scout return 963.94, 625, 320, 557, 554 (median 557); max depth 2, 1, 1, 1, 1; five deaths, one by starvation and four killed while Fainting. Each bound is the probe median times 0.7, rounded down to a multiple of 50, so a comparable baseline passes and a clear exploration regression fails.
step_cap_rationale: The 2000-step cap bounds a surviving episode. Scout cannot eat, so every probe episode ended by death between 923 and 1032 steps; the cap was never reached. Exhaustive exploration of the first level outlasted that hunger horizon on three of five probes, and a fourth finished it one step before dying, which the thresholds record rather than hide.
